_comment: Election-night broadcast per stream id (config/sources.json streams.list), pinned permanently: the stream window plays this video before (waiting room), during (live) and after (recording), live and in replay. Filled by: node scripts/find-election-streams.mjs (run again on Nov 3 afternoon as networks publish theirs). Unpinned channels only show a live stream whose title is about the election, and the scraper pins the first one it sees.
